items.headline: The official list now includes 67 fully accredited UAE eInvoicing service providers. Businesses should verify full accreditation before appointment.
Ministerial Decision No. 168 of 2026 introduces direct ASP accreditation after full assessment and testing, effective 1 October 2026.
Businesses subject to eInvoicing should select an accredited provider, contract and integrate with it, and then complete the required EmaraTax procedures.
30 October 2026 deadline: businesses with annual revenue of AED 50 million or more must appoint an Accredited Service Provider for UAE eInvoicing.
VAT returns for tax periods ending 30 September 2026 are generally due by 28 October 2026.
